decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 61675 01 received 1st December 2010 and letter and accompanying site location plan received 18th January 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for MOT purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 7:30 am to 7pm Monday to Friday, 10am to 5pm Saturdays and from 11am to 4pm Sundays.

Condition : 4 - The whole of the building shall only be occupied by one operator and only the MOT use be carried out in the part of the building that is indicated on drawing 61675 01 received 1st December 2010.
description: Change of use of the existing car repair business to include MOT testing
